question: How does the static price and initial exposure respond to bounded ray range 1, 2, and 3 on the same selected type/roots?
changed_premise: The max_steps=3 ray produced deterministic geometry-price sensitivity but zero root candidates for direction (1,0); its raw increase was nearly all empty-board expected mobility.
arms: Reuse the already-determined type per seed and same owner-relative ray direction (1,0), empty target, move-only effect and invariant; vary only max_steps in {1,2,3}. Freshly compile each arm and compare raw capability, normalized selected-type board value, profile roster deltas and opening candidate count.
measurements: raw capability delta versus legacy base
interpretation: A finite sensitivity check on this preset and exact template; range-dependent price is not a learned/calibrated value.
